A short white bar at the left edge is unlabeled.

visual.general_description: Screenshot of a dose-volume histogram with five colored curves labeled rectum, bladder, PTV5040, PTV7000 and urethra.
visual.detailed_description: Screenshot of a treatment-planning software dose-volume histogram. A tab strip at the top left reads "3D", "DVH", "BEV" and "Arc", followed by a title bar naming a plan and "Dose Volume Histogram". The plot has a y-axis titled "Ratio of Total Structure Volume [%]" with printed ticks 0, 20, 40, 60, 80 and 100, a top x-axis titled "Dose [cGy]" with printed ticks 0, 700, 1400, 2100, 2800, 3500, 4200, 4900, 5600, 6300 and 7000, and a bottom x-axis titled "Relative dose [%]" with printed ticks 0 to 100 in steps of 10. Five thick curves are drawn: dark blue, turquoise, red, yellow and brown, and white text boxes printed on the plot read "PTV5040", "Urethra", "Rectum", "Bladder" and "PTV7000". The dark-blue PTV5040 curve stays at the top and then falls steeply at a lower dose than the turquoise urethra and red PTV7000 curves, which stay at the top and fall steeply together near the right end. The yellow bladder and brown rectum curves decline gradually across the dose range from the left, and the bladder curve lies above the rectum curve over much of the middle of the range. No numeric data labels are printed on the curves.
